summary: Frontend-only regression test of BottomNav.jsx after replacing custom SVG runic icons with lucide-react icons (Trophy, Swords, BarChart2, PlusCircle, Users, Flag). Tested guest mode, admin login flow, tab visibility, navigation to all 6 routes, and active/passive color states. All acceptance criteria PASS.
action_items: (Optional / pre-existing, NOT related to BottomNav change) Fix hydration warning in AddPoints.jsx line 177 — <span> rendered inside <option> element (from dynamic i18n/label wrapper). Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav.jsx is clean, ~72 lines, uses lucide-react icons per request, colors ACTIVE=#E74C1A / INACTIVE=#666 with drop-shadow glow on active, size 22px — matches spec exactly.
Icons resolved correctly in DOM: lucide-trophy, lucide-swords, lucide-chart-no-axes-column (BarChart2), lucide-circle-plus (PlusCircle), lucide-users, lucide-flag.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BottomNav icon replacement verified end-to-end. Guest sees 2 tabs (Trophy+Swords, /, /komutanlar). Admin sees all 6 tabs in expected order; each tab navigates to correct route and shows orange active color rgb(231,76,26) with glow, passive rgb(102,102,102). Pre-existing hydration warning about <span> inside <option> exists in AddPoints.jsx — not caused by BottomNav change.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs from this iteration's change.
